name: 5dim_locale
title: 5Dim's mod - Locales
author: 5Dim
description:
Play the 5Dim suite in your language.
Adds translation support across the 5Dim collection for items, technologies, settings and menus.
[font=default-bold]Fully translated languages:[/font]
• English
• Español (es-ES)
• 简体中文 (zh-CN)
• Deutsch (de)
• Русский (ru)
• 한국어 (ko)
• Français (fr)
Other languages include partial community translations and fall back to English for missing entries.
Requires 5dim_core.
